title: Russian authorities detain suspect over St. Petersburg cafe blast
Sport helping displaced Lebanese living in stadium to cope
contentSnippet: More than a million people have been forced to flee their homes in southern Lebanon due to fighting between Israeli forces and Hezbollah. As many shelter in Beirut stadiums, sport is sometimes a welcome distraction.
